_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id}, playing {num_rounds} rounds of Iterated Ultimatum Game.
You have ${pool} to split this round between yourself and Player {other_id}.

Proposer:
  - Make an offer: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - If accepted → You get $(pool - X), other player gets $X
  - If rejected → Both get $0
  - Example: [Offer: $3]  or  'I think this is fair. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Decide on the offer with either [Accept] or [Reject]
  - Example: 'That seems reasonable. [Accept]'
            'Too unfair. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Kɩfam {round_number} pɩɣa! ---
Kɛɖɛɣa {proposer_id} kɛɖɛɣa ŋgbɛɛ, Kɛɖɛɣa {responder_id} kɛɖɛɣa tɔm.
round.offer: Kɛdɛŋ {round_number}: Kɛɖɛɣa {proposer_id} kɛ ñɩŋa ${offer} kɛ kɛɖɛɣa {responder_id} (kpɛŋ ${keep}).
round.accepted: Kɩlaŋ {responder_id} kɩlaŋɩɣ! Kɩlaŋɩɣ {round_number} naa: Kɩlaŋ {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, kɩlaŋ {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Naa kɩlaŋɩɣ: Kɩlaŋ 0: ${total_0}, kɩlaŋ 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Kɛlaɣ {responder_id} ɛtaa ɛ-kɛlɛɛ kɛ pɩsaŋ pʋʋ! Kɛlɛɛ {round_number} tɔsɩ: Pɛɛ pɛɛ +$0. Ɛsɩndatɩ wɛɛna: Kɛlaɣ 0: ${total_0}, Kɛlaɣ 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Pɩwɛɛ se weyi ɛcɔŋna tɔm ndʋ tɩ-yɔɔ yɔ, ɛtɩŋnɩ [Offer: $X] yɔɔ nɛ ɛla.
invalid_move.bad_integer: Pɩwɛɛ se liidiye nɖɩ pɛcɛlɩ-ɩ yɔ, ɖɩkɛ ɛyʊ kɩfalʊ.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Lakasɩ nzɩ sɩ-yɔɔ ŋpɩzɩɣ nɛ ŋkɔɔ lɛɛlɛɛyɔ yɔ, tɩfɛyɩ.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Responder ɛɛkpa kpɛɛ ma ɛtɩŋɛ [Accept] pee ɛtɩŋɛ [Reject] kɔcɔna

outcome.win: Kɛɖɛɣa {winner} kɛŋna kɛdɛŋ kɛ pɩnaɣ ${winner_total} yɔɔ kɛ kɛɖɛɣa {loser} kɛ pɩnaɣ ${loser_total}.
